title: Talk Structurally, Act Hierarchically: A Collaborative Framework for LLM Multi-Agent Systems
reasoning: The paper includes a significant evaluation component focused on moral and ethical reasoning. It uses the 'Moral Scenario' subtask of the MMLU benchmark as a primary evaluation domain and describes specific multi-agent workflows and prompts designed to assess 'ethical soundness,' 'fairness,' and 'moral alignment' in ethical dilemmas.
